description: This is a Bash script designed to automate testing of MCP (Management Control Plane) endpoints for the AgentField server. It includes checks for dependencies, server availability, fetches test nodes, and performs various API endpoint tests covering status, health, server restart, tools listing, error cases, and SSE events. The script provides detailed logging and handles both success and failure scenarios.

methods.name: log_info
methods.description: Logs informational messages with blue color

methods.name: log_success
methods.description: Logs success messages with green color

methods.name: log_warning
methods.description: Logs warning messages with yellow color

methods.name: log_error
methods.description: Logs error messages with red color

methods.name: check_dependencies
methods.description: Checks if required external commands jq and curl are available

methods.name: check_agentfield_server
methods.description: Verifies if the AgentField server is reachable and running

methods.name: get_test_nodes
methods.description: Fetches available nodes from the server for testing purposes

methods.name: execute_curl
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with curl, logs response and status

methods.name: test_overall_mcp_status
methods.description: Tests the overall MCP status endpoint

methods.name: test_node_mcp_health_user
methods.description: Tests MCP health endpoint for a specific node in user mode

methods.name: test_node_mcp_health_developer
methods.description: Tests MCP health endpoint for a specific node in developer mode

methods.name: test_mcp_server_restart
methods.description: Attempts to restart an MCP server on a node

methods.name: test_mcp_tools_listing
methods.description: Gets the list of available tools from MCP server

methods.name: test_error_cases
methods.description: Performs tests with invalid inputs to verify error handling

methods.name: test_sse_events
methods.description: Tries to connect to SSE events stream for testing purposes

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating all tests and initial checks
